consequence.statement: istio-cni remains a privileged container per Pod Security Standards since it keeps CAP_SYS_ADMIN; no operational consequence is stated.

original.statement: istio-cni's securityContext.privileged is now false in favor of feature-specific permissions, though it remains a privileged container (CAP_SYS_ADMIN).

consequence.statement: After upgrade the istio-cni pod runs with privileged: false and feature-specific capabilities instead of full privileged mode; it is still classified as privileged under Pod Security Standards (CAP_SYS_ADMIN). No failure is stated.
consequence.remediation: Check that any policy or tooling that inspects istio-cni's securityContext (e.g. expecting privileged: true) still behaves as intended.

corrected.statement: In Istio 1.24.0 the istio-cni container's securityContext.privileged default changes to false in favor of feature-specific permissions; istio-cni still counts as a privileged container under Pod Security Standards (CAP_SYS_ADMIN), and it keeps working with a different security context.

decision.reason: [ev-61280517f4ea] states the default securityContext.privileged for istio-cni is changed to false in favor of feature-specific permissions, i.e. the deployed pod's security context changes while istio-cni remains a privileged container per Pod Security Standards (CAP_SYS_ADMIN).
